subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finpath.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really helpful to understand FinPath's priorities on latency and cost for conversational assistants. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: low-latency inference for interactive workflows, dedicated capacity for PII handling, and SOC2/compliance visibility.
- Next step: 45-60m product demo + technical deep dive with our SE to walk throughput/latency tradeoffs and deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Could you let me know which of these slots works for your team next week?
- Tue 11/17: 9:00-10:00am PT or 2:00-3:00pm PT
- Wed 11/18: 11:00am-12:00pm PT

If procurement/security need to join, please feel free to loop them in - we can cover SOC2 summary, data retention, and the procurement questionnaire up front. I'm CC'ing Dev (SE) to join the technical deep dive. If useful, I can also loop in our security lead (Neha) so she can answer compliance questions directly.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinPath Procurement <procurement@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap - that aligns with what we discussed. We can do the demo + technical deep dive on Tue 11/17 at 2:00pm PT. I'll bring Alex Chen from our platform team and loop procurement so they can flag any PO/contract questions up front.

Procurement will likely want the standard questionnaire answered; attaching the version they typically use (see attachment). Also, can you please have your security/contact provide a SOC2 summary and an outline of data retention options? That will speed review.

Attaching: FinPath_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Walker
Head of Product, FinPath
sam.walker@finpath.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, FinPath Procurement <procurement@finpath.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Perfect - thanks Sam. 

I've booked Tue 11/17 2:00-3:00pm PT on the invite (Google Meet link below). Dev will run the demo and technical deep-dive; Neha (cc'd) will be available to cover SOC2, encryption, and retention questions. 

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

I've also attached a short SOC2 summary and an internal compliance one-pager to speed procurement review. If procurement has required contract language or a preferred SOW, please send ahead and we'll route to our legal ops.

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_Redwood.pdf

Agenda (30-45m demo + 15-30m deep dive):
- 0-15m: Product demo (low-latency examples + embeddings/rerank)
- 15-45m: SE deep dive (throughput, batching, KV cache, quant profiles)
- 45-60m: Compliance/Procurement Q&A

If anything changes on your side, let me know and we can adjust. Looking forward to the session.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa - confirmed for Tue 11/17 2:00pm PT. We'll review the SOC2 summary and questionnaire before the call and send any specific procurement questions by EOD Monday.
